decisions.reason: As a multi-model office system closely tied to the firm's stated push toward flexible workplace interiors, several years of development, presentation, and prior retention decisions make management very likely to continue backing it.
The chair family remains close to the core range and benefits from earlier visible commitment on its own page, so management would tend to justify the investment by keeping it in the portfolio.

Although the sofa had lower website prominence and is therefore the most vulnerable of the remaining products, its closeness to the established lounge and living business still gives management reasons to persist rather than admit a misstep.

The high standing table fits the firm's direction toward adaptable contemporary work and lounge settings, and the sunk design and marketing effort behind a dedicated presentation make withdrawal within a year unlikely.
